title_en: The line of descent of the Messiah
description_en: The family line through which the promised Messiah came, from Adam through Noah, Shem, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Judah and David to Jesus, following the chart 'Bible Lists of Jesus’ Genealogy' in Insight (Genealogy of Jesus Christ), which sets Genesis/Ruth, 1 Chronicles 1-3, Matthew 1 and Luke 3 side by side. From David the series follows the royal line through Solomon to Joseph (Matthew, Jesus' legal right to the throne); Luke's line through Nathan to Mary (Jesus' natural descent) has no dated members and is listed in the notes.

sources.par: Chart: Bible Lists of Jesus’ Genealogy
sources.quote_en: Luke traced the line through David’s son Nathan, instead of Solomon as did Matthew.
Jacob limited the matter by showing that the gathering of the people would be to Shiloh ... of the tribe of Judah. (Ge 49:10) Then, of all Judah, the coming seed was restricted to the line of David.
Jehovah assures King David and later his son Solomon that the promised “offspring” would come through their family line.

groups.label_en: Adam to David (Genesis and Ruth, 1 Chronicles, Luke)
groups.note: Insight: the Genesis/Ruth, 1 Chronicles and Luke lists agree fully from Adam to Arpachshad and (Genesis/Ruth and Chronicles) down to David.

groups.label_en: David to Jesus through Solomon and Joseph (Matthew 1; 1 Chronicles 3)

attributes.shows: Jesus' legal right to the throne of David through his adoptive father Joseph

groups.note: Matthew omits some names that 1 Chronicles 3 lists (Ahaziah, Jehoash, Amaziah, Jehoiakim); they are included here as in the Insight chart.

groups.label_en: David to Jesus through Nathan and Mary (Luke 3)

attributes.shows: Jesus' natural descent from David through his mother Mary, daughter of Heli

groups.note: No member has a dated record; names are listed in the series notes.

Jesus' earthly life. Insight: Matthew shows Jesus' legal right to David's throne through his adoptive father Joseph; Luke shows his natural descent from David through his mother Mary (Luke 3:23, 'son, as the opinion was, of Joseph, son of Heli').

notes: Undated ancestors (no record in the data, so not members): Enosh; Kenan (Cainan, Luke 3:37); Mahalalel; Eber; Judah (and Tamar); Perez; Hezron; Ram (Arni, Luke 3:33); Amminadab; Nahshon; Obed; Jesse; Shealtiel; Joseph (legal father); and, in Matthew after Zerubbabel, Abiud, Eliakim, Azor, Zadok, Achim, Eliud, Eleazar, Matthan, Jacob. Luke's line (Luke 3:23-31) from David's son Nathan: Nathan, Mattatha, Menna, Melea, Eliakim, Jonam, Joseph, Judas, Symeon, Levi, Matthat, Jorim, Eliezer, Jesus, Er, Elmadam, Cosam, Addi, Melchi, Neri, Shealtiel, Zerubbabel, Rhesa, Joanan, Joda, Josech, Semein, Mattathias, Maath, Naggai, Esli, Nahum, Amos, Mattathias, Joseph, Jannai, Melchi, Levi, Matthat, Heli (father of Mary), then Mary, mother of Jesus. Judah: Jacob's blessing limited the line to Shiloh of the tribe of Judah (Gen. 49:10; Insight 'Seed'); jw.org gives no birth or death date for Judah, so he has no member. David: the Kingdom covenant (b3-0009, after 1070 B.C.E.; 2 Sam. 7:12-16) restricted the line to David's descendants (NWT App. B1; Insight 'Seed'). Order = generation number counted from Adam (Matthew's names after Zerubbabel fill generations 54-62, then Joseph 63 and Jesus 64). Salmon and Boaz are represented by context records for Rahab and the book of Ruth. label_en follows the Insight chart; Tamil names are copied from the Tamil NWT (Matthew 1, Luke 3; Kenan as 'காயினான்', Luke 3:37-38) and, for kings Matthew omits, from Tamil NWT App. A6. Insight has no Tamil WOL page (404), so series title and descriptions are English only.
